name: Publish
description: Publish a file or folder from the sandbox to the private pages site and return its link: a standalone page to share (a plan, a table, a write-up), a chart, a CSV. An HTML file becomes the page; a folder is published whole, with its index.html as the page (keep charts and images beside it and link them relatively). Pages are static: scripts don't run and nothing loads from other hosts, but CSS in <style> or style="" works. This workspace's pages are its /public folder, synced to the site whenever a run or write-file there ends; publish copies a file or folder from elsewhere into /public/<slug> and syncs, and with no path it forces a sync (of the slug, or of everything). Publishing to a slug this workspace already has replaces it, and a slug another workspace has is taken; `ls /public` in run-code lists this workspace's pages. remove deletes /public's entry for the slug, taking the page down.
author: anything

examples.prompt: Put the trip plan on a page I can open on my phone
Take the trip plan page down

path.description: The file or folder in the sandbox to copy into /public/<slug>, e.g. '/work/report' or '/project/chart.png'. Leave it out to sync what's already in /public.

slug.description: The page's name in its URL: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, e.g. 'trip-plan'.

remove.description: Set true to take the page at slug down instead (no path needed).
